title: Community Data License Agreement – Permissive, Version 2.0
version_or_date: Version 2.0 (licence text undated; site footer reads Copyright © 2017 The Linux Foundation)

parties.licensor: Data Provider(s): any person who is the source of the Data provided under the agreement; the Linux Foundation publishes the template and is not named as a party
parties.licensee: Data Recipient(s): any person who receives the Data directly or indirectly from a Data Provider and agrees to the terms
parties.operator_role: not_applicable (template licence between providers and recipients; no marketplace or intermediary role is defined)

permitted_use.value: Any recipient may use, modify and share the Data, subject only to the agreement's terms; public-domain portions, and uses allowed by other legal exceptions, are not restricted at all.

ai_training_rights.value: Training is not named, but the grant covers any use and modification, and 'Results' (any outcome of computational analysis, expressly including machine learning models and models' insights) carry no restriction or obligation. Training, fine-tuning, evaluation, model redistribution and output use are therefore all unrestricted; redistributing the Data itself only requires the licence text to go with it.

field_of_use.value: No field-of-use limit: the grant is general (use, modify, share), with no commercial/non-commercial or sector restriction stated.

sublicensing.value: No sublicence mechanism. Recipients may share the Data (modified or not) onward if they include the agreement text, and anyone receiving it 'directly or indirectly' from a provider becomes a Data Recipient on the same terms.

derivatives_and_model_outputs.value: Modification is allowed and modified Data can be shared on the same condition (agreement text included). Results, including ML models and their insights, are free of any restriction or obligation, so they need no attribution or licence text and are not copyleft.

attribution.value: The only condition on sharing Data is to make the text of the agreement available with it. There is no separate attribution or notice-retention duty, and none at all for Results.

warranties_by_provider.value: None. The Data is provided 'as is', and warranties of title, non-infringement, merchantability and fitness for purpose are expressly disclaimed.

liability_cap.value: Providers have no liability at all (a cap of zero) for direct, indirect, incidental, special, exemplary or consequential damages, including lost profits, arising from the Data or the Results, on any theory. Recipient liability is not addressed.

claims.statement: The document is the Community Data License Agreement – Permissive, Version 2.0, and states that it is an agreement between Data Provider(s) and Data Recipient(s).

unknowns.note: No party warrants the consent or releases of people depicted in the Data. The general 'as is' disclaimer (c007) leaves that risk with the recipient.
No mechanism to withdraw Data, act on a data subject's erasure request, or require deletion of copies or Results a recipient already holds.
The grant is not labelled exclusive or non-exclusive. Because any recipient may re-share (c004), no exclusivity can in practice be given under this licence alone.
No duration, termination or revocation clause.
No termination clause, so no duty to delete on termination.
No prohibited or restricted uses are listed (for example, nothing on re-identification or biometric use).
No fee, royalty or payment terms.
No clause on later versions or on amending the terms.
